client_admin: First setup: Settings, then Organizations (the ASPs and their first admin), Sites and warehouses, Model catalog, Sorting, Users.
Import sites, warehouses and models from Excel with «Import»: check the Preview first.
You create transfers between two ASPs from Shipments; you confirm returns like the Client warehouse.
Correct pieces from their page: Office force, Merge, Accept move.
Every management action is kept in the Admin log.
client_office: The Dashboard shows the pieces of all ASPs or of one: tap a number to open the list.
In Pieces search by full code or filter by status, ASP, location and model.
In Documents press «Compare» to see arrived, missing and unexpected pieces of a DDT or a BOM.
In Alerts press «Mark seen»; closing alerts is up to the admins.
Exports and Reports: download data in Excel and the monthly report, also for a single ASP.
client_warehouse: In Shipments open the «Sent» return and press «Confirm».
Untick the pieces that did not arrive; type the code of extra pieces and press «Add».
If a piece arrives later, reopen the same return and confirm again: confirmed pieces are not counted twice.
«DDT (return) difference» alerts tell you what does not match: close them only once it is clear.
asp_admin: Invite warehouse staff and technicians from People; for someone leaving use «Deactivate», «Block now» only for a lost phone.
Upload the sites' BOMs from Documents: each line goes in «To remove» or «To install».
Correct your ASP's pieces from their page, always with a reason.
You can do everything the ASP warehouse does; Dashboard, Exports and Reports show only your ASP.
asp_warehouse: Choose the warehouse in Home and check it at the top before scanning: every scan is recorded there.
«Arrival»: choose New or Removed material and, for new material, the DDT; then scan the pieces (turn on «Burst» to scan them in a row).
«Sort / classify»: confirm the suggested category with one tap or tap another; for many identical pieces set a fixed category.
Returns and transfers: create the draft in Shipments, press «Scan pieces», then «Send».
Complete pieces without a model from «To complete».
asp_technician: Search the site by code or name: it works offline too.
Press «Scan», choose «Remove» or «Install» and scan the pieces one after another.
Unknown piece: choose the model or press «Skip», the piece is recorded anyway.
When the work is done press «I have finished at this site».
Install the app on your phone and do not sign out while «waiting to be sent» shows at the top.
